profile.headline: Software Engineer and Designer
profile.summary:
Greetings! I’m a software engineer and designer skilled in programming languages like Java and C++, web and graphic design, video editing, illustration, and interactive media. 

I am always interested in new opportunities, so feel free to contact me.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: Software Development · React.js · .NET Framework · Microsoft SQL Server · Problem Solving · Communication · SQL · Spreadsheets · Databases

positions.title: Freelance Graphic, Multimedia, and Web Designer
positions.description: Projects range from designing promotional flyers (for print and web), info-graphics, and data graphs, to coding websites using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

positions.title: Engineer II Software
positions.description: Projects include using C#, .Net, and LINQ to solve problems and create efficiency-improving programs, updating and querying MySQL databases, and troubleshooting server and database problems.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Problem Solving · Communication · Databases

positions.title: CIDSE Tutor
positions.description: Assisted ASU CIDSE students in the understanding, learning, and retention of programming-related concepts introduced in their undergraduate classes.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Projects included researching and utilizing static analysis tools such as SonarQube to analyze coding errors in C++ programs and creating a C# program that utilized database and spreadsheet information.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Problem Solving · Communication

positions.title: Open Source Software Developer Intern
positions.description: Took part in an agile development team to find and fix bugs, decouple code, and program new features in Java.

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description:
Responsibilities ranged from designing visual ads, e-mails, site banners, social media sites,
promotional videos, print mail advertisements, and branded t-shirts to coding website pages and promotional e-mails using primarily HTML and CSS.

positions.title: Part Time Contributing Graphics Assistant
positions.description: Assisted production team with creating graphics for stories as needed (using Illustrator).

positions.title: Part Time Contributing Writer
positions.description:
Wrote monthly column “Clinical Edge” for Medtech Insight Newsletter. Column dealt with
recent medical research advances in the fields of medical devices and biotechnology.

positions.title: Student Worker
positions.description: Operated the FIB electron microscope at ASU Tempe campus.

educations.schoolName: Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering at Arizona State University

honors.title: 2nd place team
honors.issuer: Issued by 2017 Women in Computer Science Programming Competition · Jan 2017

honors.title: Moeur Award
honors.description: Requires a cumulative 4.0 GPA at ASU.

projects.title: Broaden Your Horizons GIT Poster
projects.description: A poster created using Photoshop and photo manipulation techniques for a final project in GIT 334.
